items.headline: China prepares next phase of national SME fund to boost tech start-ups and IPOs
items.detail: China will soon launch the second phase of a National SME Development Fund with a focus on IPO incubation and channelling private capital into backing innovative, early-stage entities and projects with long-term prospects in hard tech.

items.headline: Hong Kong regulator reclassifies certain funds with exposure to private markets
items.detail: Hong Kong’s market regulator has reclassified some of the city’s authorised funds with exposure to private market assets above a certain amount as complex products, raising the threshold for selling these products to retail investors.

items.headline: Philippine fast-food giant Jollibee picks Hong Kong over New York for spin-off’s listing
items.detail: The parent company of Philippine fast-food giant Jollibee plans to spin off and list its international operations in Hong Kong instead of New York in a strong endorsement of the city’s initial public offering (IPO) diversification efforts.

items.headline: Shein slips on Hong Kong debut amid fast-fashion challenges
items.detail: Fast-fashion retailer Shein fell on its Hong Kong trading debut as the unprofitable company contends with rising competition and the loss of tax breaks in key markets.
